=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- File: scripts/render_prompt.py
  Line: 1334-1338
  Problem: The identity-recall block injection is applied BEFORE render_prompt_text() substitutes the placeholders, but inject_identity_recall_block() searches for "Role: ... Goal:" patterns that only exist in rendered output. This causes the injection to fail silently (returns unaltered text) when the flag is enabled.
  Why it fails at runtime: When UNATTENDED_IDENTITY_REINJECT_ENABLED=true, the identity block is never actually injected because the function looks for role/goal metadata in unrendered template text which contains {{placeholder}} tokens instead of actual role/goal content. The function returns the original text unchanged.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: scripts/render_prompt.py  
  Line: 604
  Problem: Function signature expects `rendered_prompt_text` as the first argument but the call site passes unrendered template text. The name is misleading - it suggests it works on rendered output but the implementation tries to inject before rendering.
  Why it fails at runtime: The inject logic looks for "Role: ... Goal:" paragraph end offset, which only exists after template substitution. With unrendered text, the paragraph detection fails and returns None, falling back to a naive append at the end of the prompt.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===
- File: scripts/render_scenario_trace.py
  Line: 293-301
  Problem: The finalization logic moved outside the inner loop still allows the last assistant_text step to be dropped when an excerpt ends exactly on a marker line
  Why it fails at runtime: The parser finalizes an open block after each excerpt, but when the final line of text is itself `<<< [model]`, the assistant_text content is lost because `current.lines` remains empty (the marker line is detected as the end, not as content)
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: scripts/render_scenario_trace.py
  Line: 317
  Problem: The added `saw_marker` check after the inner loop incorrectly raises TraceParseError even when prior excerpts were valid, aborting the entire batch
  Why it fails at runtime: The outer flag is never set for excerpts containing markers, causing the first "marker-free" excerpt after valid ones to falsely abort processing of the entire report
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: scripts/render_prompt.py
  Line: 1338-1340
  Problem: Identity recall injection path in render_prompt.py unconditionally applies the block when env flag is truthy, while render_prompt.sh wraps Python renderer call with same flag set to false, creating double-injection risk or block omission
  Why it fails at runtime: Prompt rendering can emit duplicate or malformed `<identity-recall>` blocks (e.g. `<identity-recall> ... <identity-recall>` or missing the block entirely), breaking the repo's cross-implementation contract
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
